description: This file defines a Helper class with utility methods for event handling, browsing context collection, observer management, ID generation, and error status retrieval, as well as an EventWatcher class for managing event subscriptions and promises.

classes.name: Helper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for event decoration, browsing context collection, observer management, ID generation, and error handling.

classes.name: EventWatcher
classes.description: A class for monitoring multiple events on a receiver, ensuring specific events occur, and managing event listeners and promises.

methods.name: decorateAsEventEmitter
methods.description: Decorates an object to behave as an event emitter by binding emitter methods.

methods.name: collectAllBrowsingContexts
methods.description: Recursively collects all browsing contexts starting from a root context.

methods.name: awaitTopic
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a specific topic is observed.

methods.name: toProtocolNavigationId
methods.description: Generates a protocol-specific navigation ID string.

methods.name: addObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for a topic and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: addMessageListener
methods.description: Adds a message listener to a receiver and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: addEventListener
methods.description: Adds an event listener to a receiver and returns a function to remove it, with error handling.

methods.name: awaitEvent
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a specific event occurs on a receiver.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Wraps a receiver's on method to fire event listeners without the first argument.

methods.name: addProgressListener
methods.description: Adds a progress listener and returns a function to remove it.

methods.name: generateId
methods.description: Generates a UUID string without braces.

methods.name: getLoadContext
methods.description: Retrieves the load context from a channel.

methods.name: getNetworkErrorStatusText
methods.description: Returns a string description of a network error status code.

methods.name: browsingContextToFrameId
methods.description: Converts a browsing context to a frame ID string.
